**Finding submitted: deviation (LICENSE), fallback-level cure.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4(c) (p0021) is the only grant running to us — a royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual, sublicensable licence in Contractor's Information incorporated into the Works. It is not revocable at will, so this is not walk-away territory.
- **Why fallback fails:** "Company" is defined as Clear Capital alone (p0002), with no affiliate coverage and no notice mechanic; Section 10 (p0042) bars assignment or transfer of the Agreement or its rights without Contractor's consent, so the licence would not survive into an M&A successor.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence after p0021 carrying only the two missing fallback elements — affiliate extension on written notice, and transferability to an M&A successor "without Contractor's approval" (expressed directly rather than via a broad override of the non-assignment clause). Preferred-level items (contractor coverage, express irrevocability, breach-only termination) were noted, not pressed.
